findings.current: “Have you been—listen to this damn bastard.”
findings.defect: The Korean greeting is interrupted by a remark about the way the narrator speaks. “Listen to this damn bastard” shifts the reaction to the person rather than his manner of speaking.
findings.rationale: The phrase “이 빌어먹을 놈이 말하는 본새 보게” specifically calls out how the bastard talks.
findings.replacement: “Have you been—look at the way this damn bastard talks.”

findings.current: And just as all those worries and thoughts began chasing one another in endless circles—
findings.defect: “Endless circles” adds a sense of unending repetition and circular motion not established by the Korean idiom.
findings.rationale: “꼬리와 꼬리를 물고 이어지던” describes thoughts following one another in a chain, not circling endlessly.
findings.replacement: And just as one worry and thought led to another—

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, but a few lines alter or omit source-specific details.
